title: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management: billing meter change for non-Microsoft 365 AI retention
summary: The briefing accurately reports the planned meter change and preserves the roadmap's unresolved distinction between storage and message pricing. The existing controls and consumption billing are supported; the retention-policy route could be completed and its AI application preview qualification should be added.

claims.claim: Solutions > Data Lifecycle Management > Policies > Retention policies > New retention policy opens the relevant policy configuration in the Microsoft Purview portal.
claims.quote: Sign in to the Microsoft Purview portal > Solutions > Data Lifecycle Management > Policies > Retention policies. ... Select New retention policy to start the Create retention policy configuration
claims.fix: The route correctly opens the wizard but stops before its scope control. For the documented static-policy route, use 'Solutions > Data Lifecycle Management > Policies > Retention policies > New retention policy > Assign admin units > Full directory > Choose the type of retention policy to create > Static > Choose locations to apply the policy' as documented at https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/create-retention-policies.

claims.claim: New-AppRetentionCompliancePolicy -Name <String> -Applications <String[]> creates an app retention policy and selects the applications it includes.
claims.quote: Use the New-AppRetentionCompliancePolicy to create app retention compliance policies. ... The Applications parameter specifies the applications to include in the policy.

claims.claim: Microsoft Copilot experiences, Enterprise AI apps and Other AI apps are available app-retention policy locations.
claims.quote: Microsoft Copilot experiences: Currently in Preview. ... Enterprise AI apps: Currently in Preview. ... Other AI apps: Currently in Preview.
claims.fix: Add 'The cmdlet reference currently marks these three AI application location groups as Preview.' to controls[0].note and the rendered row, citing https://learn.microsoft.com/powershell/module/exchangepowershell/new-appretentioncompliancepolicy. This qualification concerns the existing retention locations, not the roadmap meter's General Availability release phase.
